Overview

Ústí nad Labem is a city in Ústí nad Labem with a population of 92,000. A North Bohemian city on the Elbe River, surrounded by the Czech Central Highlands with a dramatic castle overlooking the old town. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
